hook_anchors.excerpt: Gerald has made his choice. Accept it, Juliana.
hook_anchors.why: The father's utter abandonment of his own humiliated daughter shocks the audience.

hook_anchors.excerpt: You look like a kitchen maid who wandered into the wrong wedding.
hook_anchors.why: Spiteful mockery from the sister adds layers to the public humiliation.

hook_anchors.excerpt: You have shown them something far more valuable.
hook_anchors.why: Juliana begins to turn the tables, shifting from victim to accuser with fierce conviction.

hook_anchors.excerpt: I will not leave it believing I was the one who should be ashamed.
